$comment_block: End-to-end validation of the 2026-07-26 fix batch. Each experiment isolates ONE claim so the check is falsifiable: the pairs marked NO-OP must come back byte-identical to their control, and the pairs marked EFFECT must differ. simbench_lv_small at 10 s keeps a task to a few minutes locally.
name: eval_e2e_validate

experiments.$comment: NO-OP + EFFECT for holon_watchdog_s. Arm 1 states the shipped default explicitly and MUST be byte-identical to the control (proves replacing the hardcoded 30.0 with the config field changed nothing). Arm 2 must differ (proves the knob is live).
experiments.name: v_watchdog

ablations.$allow_default_valued: NO-OP control: must be byte-identical to the baseline

experiments.$comment: EFFECT for the priority-weighting fix. enable_priority_holon_allocation=False was BIT-IDENTICAL to the default across all 15 seeds in eval_full_v2 because the stable-sort tie-break reproduced the priority order. With _prorata_target it must now differ. The default arm is the control and must be unchanged by the fix (it takes the same _waterfall_target branch as before).
experiments.name: v_priority_weighting

experiments.$comment: NO-OP + EFFECT for heat_node_reg_kgs. cold_day with a cold supply and 1.5x heat load is the regime the campaign's sub-ambient t_k records came from (ablation_thermal / just_heat / cold_day on cp_heavy); a clean scenario keeps every junction flowing and cannot exercise the fix. Scenario 1 omits the key (shipped path), 2 states 0.0 and must match it, 3 at 1e-6 must change the heat state. The oracle applies the McCormick heat MILP and must be immune to all three.
experiments.name: v_heat_regulariser

experiments.$comment: EFFECT for oracle_time_limit_s. 1.0 s left one seed with no incumbent at all (correctly refused as ungradeable), which proves the knob but breaks the paired comparison; 5 s still forces a non-optimal solve while keeping a usable solution. Control solves optimal in ~12 s.
experiments.name: v_oracle_budget
